metadata.title: fix: Make sure "enabled" is set correctly in resource updates
metadata.author: gabe-l-hart

description:
Without this, the update will always fail because creation of the return object will raise a validation error.

Edit: There is a similar issue with `_convert_tool_to_read` where the `tool` fetched from the DB is lazily evaluated and when `tool.__dict__.copy()` is called, it can be un-evaluated resulting in many missing fields in the final `tool_dict` that gets validated for return.

commits.message:
fix: Make sure "enabled" is set correctly in resource udpates

Without this, the update will always fail because creation of the return
object will raise a validation error.

Branch: FixResourceUpdate

Signed-off-by: Gabe Goodhart <ghart@us.ibm.com>
